name: D1 Harbour
about: Made by tools/buildimport (python -m buildimport export). Template space: x east, z south, origin (0,0,0) = the box's north-west corner at its lowest stored y. Rotation turns the whole town about rotation_pivot; every tile shares the town's origin (tile.offset is its corner).

anchor.note: place template y = 0 at world y = target_sea_level - sea_level

legend.0: blend: not stored; Phase 3 blends generated terrain here
legend.1: mold: the build, stored exactly from floor to top
legend.2: support: ground the build stands in, stored from floor to top
legend.3: sea: open water at sea level, stored from seabed floor to the surface

zones.contract: above a stored column's top: air. Below its floor: solid ground (the placer fills down to existing solid ground). Support depth below terrain: 4 blocks.

blend.edge_format: [x, z, ground y, top y, zone]

markers.note: main street entry from the Castle Quarter (no gate building here)
largest open square in the district (upper town)
north pier, near its landward end
middle of the quay, facing the sea

workshop.note: the workshop world holds template space at this origin; its x/z keep the original's chunk alignment so the survey rules classify blocks the same way
